description: nf-core/rnavar samplesheet context, aligned to the pinned 1.3.0 schema. GATK4 RNA-seq short-variant calling.

skip_baserecalibration.help: TRUE by curated default: BQSR needs dbsnp + known_indels, and neither is provisioned in the Luria refs tree. Set false only when those are supplied.

pipeline.name: nf-core/rnavar
pipeline.core_rule: Columns are sample, fastq_1, fastq_2. The schema also accepts bam/cram/vcf inputs, but the supported path here is FASTQ.

validation_rules: The file consumed by the pipeline must be comma-separated (CSV).
sample and fastq_1 must be populated; fastq_2 blank means single-end.
Leave skip_baserecalibration TRUE unless dbsnp and known_indels have been supplied — BQSR silently needs both.
Variant annotation (snpEff/VEP) needs cached databases that are not provisioned; do not promise annotated output by default.
notes: RNA-seq variant calling. star_index, fasta_fai and dict are derived from FASTA+GTF when absent; the Luria refs tree has none of them, so the first run per genome pays a build.

sources.label: nf-core/rnavar nextflow_schema.json @ 1.3.0
sources.notes: Authoritative param names, types and defaults for the pinned revision.

sources.label: nf-core/rnavar assets/schema_input.json @ 1.3.0
sources.notes: Authoritative required/optional samplesheet columns and allowed values.

samplesheet_columns.description: Column-level field dictionary for the nf-core/rnavar input samplesheet.

sample.description: Custom sample name; repeat across lanes of one library.
sample.validation_hints: Prefer the NExtSEEK D.SEQ UID so results map back to the sample record.

fastq_1.validation_hints: Absolute Luria path, taken from the sample's Link_PrimaryData / File_PrimaryData.

fastq_2.validation_hints: Blank for single-end; keep the header.

seq_platform.description: Per-sample sequencing platform for the BAM read-group PL tag.
seq_platform.validation_hints: Only set per-row when platforms differ; otherwise use the global param.

seq_center.description: Per-sample sequencing center for the read-group CN tag.
seq_center.validation_hints: Only set per-row when centers differ.

report_writer_guidance.purpose: Build an nf-core/rnavar samplesheet from a resolved NExtSEEK D.SEQ cohort of RNA-seq libraries.
report_writer_guidance.workflow_role: Selected when the user asks for variants FROM RNA-seq. For DNA variant calling use sarek instead.
population_priority: One row per D.SEQ leaf; sample = the UID.
Map R1/R2 from the sample's primary-data metadata.
State plainly that base recalibration and variant annotation are off by default and why.
final_checks: The BQSR / annotation limitation has been surfaced to the user.
